chapter_role: Azami resolves the present spatial scale of continuous capitulum traits; EAzami advances from functional validation to repeated history, historical-class discrimination, and convergence or adaptive-convergence tests.
chapter_synthesis: Continuous capitulum traits occupy distinct present-day spatial scales and align with different environmental gradients; neither a taxon mean nor one whole-capitulum syndrome captures that geography, and retrospective composition checks distinguish geographically extensive coverage from representative sampling.

narrative_axis.primary_unit: continuous trait x environmental gradient x spatial scale, with explicit measurement, q, spatial, sampling-composition and historical gate status
narrative_axis.azami: present distribution across head, photograph, within-taxon, among-taxon and sampled global scales
narrative_axis.whole_capitulum_role: secondary synthesis that rejects one universal syndrome and tests partial measurement-module organization
narrative_axis.eazami: four evidence-gated series from candidate function to adaptive-convergence testing
eazami_series: EAzami-I: annotate and validate candidate functions for each component
EAzami-II: reconstruct origin timing and repeated history of each admitted functional trait on the nuclear ancestry set
EAzami-III: discriminate phylogenetic retention, independent origin, ancestral polymorphism and introgression
EAzami-IV: test functional convergence and, only with common selection pressure plus fitness evidence, adaptive convergence
narrative_axis.handoff_rule: Transfer trait definitions, uncertainty, distributions, geography, environmental associations, scale classes and measurement, q, spatial, sampling-composition and historical gate status; do not invent post hoc categories, let function choose history, or promote spatial association to cause.

hypotheses.scope: 46,276 observations; 259 source-assigned taxa; 18 measured inferential endpoints
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The frozen workflow reproducibly produces repeated numerical image phenotypes.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Independent measurement accuracy has been established.

hypotheses.scope: 22 measured endpoints from the full 27-endpoint registry
hypotheses.key_result: raw below-taxon fraction 0.814-0.986; equal-two-per-taxon median range 0.287-0.585
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Taxon means discard substantial repeated visible phenotype information.
hypotheses.not_allowed: The variance is genetic, heritable or plastic.

hypotheses.scope: 127 taxa complete across 18 measured inferential endpoints
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The expanded taxon morphospace remains multidimensional.
hypotheses.not_allowed: One principal component is a universal biological syndrome.

hypotheses.scope: 26 inferential units x nine predictors; primary among-taxon min5 comparison
hypotheses.key_result: 7 both scales; 18 within only; 3 among only; 152 neither; 54 not comparable
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Endpoint-environment organization differs between within- and among-taxon scales across all six frozen blocks.
hypotheses.not_allowed: The same process or mechanism generated both scales.

hypotheses.scope: 36 q-supported endpoint-environment pairs across 674 declared retrospective composition scenarios
hypotheses.key_result: 16 of 26 within-taxon rows and all 10 among-taxon rows retain direction under every applicable scenario; four of five within-taxon broad-space passes and both final among-taxon candidates are composition-stable
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The observed associations differ in sensitivity to taxon and regional composition, and the two final candidate directions survive the declared composition checks.
hypotheses.not_allowed: The photograph sample is geographically representative, or retrospective stability supplies a new significance test.

hypotheses.scope: global-q-supported rows followed by retrospective sampling-composition, v2-native broad-space and 52-tree historical-placement sensitivities
hypotheses.key_result: chroma-rsds negative and orientation-BIO12 positive retain direction in all 18 applicable composition scenarios, pass the among-taxon broad-space gate and retain direction and support on all 52 placement trees
hypotheses.allowed_claim: These two rows are adaptive-pattern candidates under current controls.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Adaptation, selection, causal mechanism, independent origin or convergence has been demonstrated.

hypotheses.key_result: within contrast 0.164502; among contrast 0.088475; both positive with bootstrap intervals excluding zero
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Registered measurement modules show partial phenotypic organization at both scales.
hypotheses.not_allowed: The modules are validated functional, developmental or genetic modules.

hypotheses.allowed_claim: Within- and among-taxon phenotype geometry is positively but incompletely aligned.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Within-taxon covariance is a miniature version of among-taxon covariance.

hypotheses.scope: 18D response; frozen core four plus five process variables
hypotheses.key_result: within process partial R2 0.013535, P=0.24468; among partial R2 0.214978, P=0.000700; growing-season precipitation stable at both thresholds among taxa
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The core four are adequate within taxa but do not exhaust among-taxon environmental structure.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Growing-season precipitation directly caused the phenotype.

hypotheses.allowed_claim: Coefficient geometry is descriptive and uncertain.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Opposing selection or stable directional rotation has been demonstrated.

hypotheses.key_result: complete 234-row endpoint-gradient status grid plus spatial, sampling-composition and historical gate statuses exported
hypotheses.allowed_claim: EAzami receives a frozen present-day target bundle for the gated I-function, II-history, III-origin-class and IV-convergence series.
hypotheses.not_allowed: EAzami reproduction upgrades Azami observations to causal effects.

hypotheses.key_result: length-width by BIO15 and apical taper by BIO12 are quality-robust C-grade; bract projection p95 by BIO15 is image-sensitive; no candidate among-taxon FDR rows
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Finer image geometry identifies exploratory within-taxon environmental structure with graded image-quality robustness.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Direct botanical or defensive effects are established.

hypotheses.scope: former responsiveness index and quadrant story
hypotheses.key_result: the relation was precision and sample-size sensitive
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The old lability story is statistical provenance only.
hypotheses.not_allowed: High-variation taxa are generally less environmentally responsive.

hypotheses.scope: rain, radiation, thermal, aerodynamic, pollinator, antagonist and defensive mechanisms
hypotheses.key_result: literature annotations generate downstream hypotheses only
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Azami identifies spatial patterns that motivate mechanistic tests.
hypotheses.not_allowed: Any named mechanism is demonstrated by Chapter 1.
